title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1+2+POST PARKIMI TEK KOPSHTI BOTANIK ‼️
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 + post parkimi prane Kopshtit Botanik, me dokumentacion te rregullt ,Certifikate Pronesie
SIPERFAQE:
- Siperfaqe e brendeshme 110 m2
- Siperfaqe e perbashket 14 m2
- Siperfaqe totale 124 m2
ORGANIZIMI :
- Sallon me dalje ne ballkon.
- Ambient te vecuar gatimi.
- Koridor I bollshem.
- 3 dhoma gjumi me hapsira.
- 2 tualete me dritare te bollshme.
ORIENTIMI:
Apartamenti ka nje orientim fantastik Lindje-Jug-Perendim, eshte totalisht zone e qete nga ana akustike sepse nuk ka levizje makinash dhe nuk ka ndotje.
INVESTIMI:
Apartamenti eshte i investuar me cilesi, i mobiluar me detaje dhe me kujdes :
- Parket Druri.
- Salloni eshte mobiluar me cilesi te larte, divan kolltuk, ambazhur, tavolina, piktura, pasqyra, lekura, tapete, perde, etj.
- Kuzhina e bollshme , e kompletuar me punime cilesore, material Druri, bango Mermer te Zi, mekanizma te ndryshem Inox, Paisje Gorenje set Ora-Ito , Tavoline Druri + Bibloteke ne krah anash te koridorit.
- Koridori eshte i bollshem me vend pushimi e bere me tapiceri lekure, dollap etj.
- Me 3 Dhomat e gjumit jan te kompletuara totalisht dhe mobilimi eshte zgjedhur me kujdes, klasike, neoklasike dhe moderne, duke ber qe cdo ambient te jete ndryshe dhe i vecante, TV, etj.
- Me 2 Tualete te bollshme dhe me paisje te kohes, punime cilesie te larte, 2 lavatrice larje dhe tharje, 2 sisteme dushi me gaz dhe me korent per ujin e ngrohte, fasad xhami, piasje inox cilesore, dollap dhe kosha druri me porosi, etj.
- Punime me Gipse te varura dhe Allci ne te gjith shtepine te ndryshme dhe me ndricim te fshehte Led, gjithashtu edhe Spote.
- Ambazhure Kristali dhe me Led te ndryshem me varesi te ambjenteve.
- Disponon nje oxhak funksional ne ngrohje.
- Sistem Kondicionimi ne ftohje.
- Pajisje hidraulike te kohes cilesore, dushi me fasade xhami e mbyllur dhe e bollshme,
- 2 Sisteme per ngrohje te uji me Kaldai eshte me gaz (ekonomik) dhe dushi me korent.
- Sistemi elektrik cilesor Schnaider, Biticna
- Fasade Xhami Termike ne Sallon me sistem Grilash te komanduar, te cilesise se larte.
- Vetrata xhami te nje cilesie te larte.
- Te gjitha pajisjet elektro-shtepiake jane Gorenjo set Ora-Ito.
ZONA:
Zona perreth ku ndodhet apartamenti ofron facilitete si : Kopshti Botanik, Liqeni Artificial, Aksesi Hyrje-Dalje ne Autostrade, Kopshte, Frmaci, Supermarkete, Gym, Park Lojerash etj.
Ka nje planimetri te rregullt dhe eshte i organizuar me se miri.
Apartamentit nuk i mungon asgje ,gati per tu banuar , me te gjithe mobilimin e kohes dhe i kompletuar totalisht me materiale cilesore.
Tre dhoma gjumi,kuzhine dy tualete dhe ballkon.
POST PARKIMI I PERFSHIRE NE CMIM !
Mundesi negocimi .
Mundesi blerje me Financim bankar.
Per me shume info ju lutem me kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+2+PARKING SPACE NEAR THE BOTANICAL GARDEN ‼️
description_en: For sale Apartment 3+1+2 + parking post near the Botanical Garden, with regular documentation, Certificate of Ownership AREA: - Internal surface 110 m2 - Common surface 14 m2 - Total surface 124 m2 ORGANIZATION: - Living room with exit to the balcony. - Separate cooking environment. - Spacious corridor. - 3 bedrooms with spaces. - 2 toilets with large windows. ORIENTATION: The apartment has a fantastic East-South-West orientation, it is a totally quiet area acoustically because there is no movement of cars and no pollution. INVESTMENT: The apartment is invested with quality, furnished with detail and care: - Wooden parquet. - The living room is furnished with high quality, sofa, armchair, lampshade, tables, paintings, mirrors, leather, carpets, curtains, etc. - Spacious kitchen, complete with quality work, Wood material, Black Marble countertops, various stainless steel mechanisms, Gorenje set Ora-Ito, Wooden Table + Bookshelves on the side of the corridor. - The corridor is spacious with a resting place made with leather upholstery, closet, etc. - The 3 bedrooms are fully furnished and the furniture is carefully chosen, classic, neoclassical and modern, making each room different and special, TV, etc. - With 2 spacious toilets and modern equipment, high quality work, 2 washing machines and dryers, 2 gas and running shower systems for hot water, glass facade, quality stainless steel dishes, wardrobe and custom wooden baskets, etc. - Works with hanging Gypsum and Allci in the whole house and with hidden LED lighting, also Spots. - Crystal lampshades with different LEDs depending on the environment. - It has a functional fireplace for heating. - Cooling Air Conditioning System. - High-quality plumbing equipment, shower with a closed and spacious glass facade, - 2 systems for heating water with a gas boiler (economical) and a shower with running water. - Schnaider quality electrical system, Biticna - Thermal Glass Facade in the Salon with controlled Grill system, of high quality. - Glass windows of a high quality. - All household appliances are Gorenjo set Ora-Ito. AREA: The area around where the apartment is located offers facilities such as: Botanical Garden, Artificial Lake, Entrance-Exit Access to the Autostrade, Gardens, Pharmacy, Supermarkets, Gym, Playground, etc. It has a regular layout and is well organized. The apartment lacks nothing, ready to live in, with all the furniture of the time and completely complete with quality materials. Three bedrooms, kitchen, two bathrooms and a balcony. PARKING POST INCLUDED IN THE PRICE! Possibility of negotiation. Possibility of purchase with bank financing. For more information, please contact me.
